title: General Grievous
subtitle: Confederacy of Independent Systems
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: As the cybernetic general of the Droid armies of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, General Grievous was one of the most important players in the battles of the Clone Wars. A feared Jedi hunter -trained to kill them by Count Dooku himself- he collected the Lightsabers of the Jedi he had beated in battle. Unfortunately, he was no match for Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.
